description: State that can be computed from other state or props. Derive it during render instead.
The same data stored twice (e.g. a selected object copied out of a list). Store an id and look it up.
Combinations such as `isSending && isSent`. Replace booleans with a single status value.
Flattening nested data into objects keyed by id, referencing children by id.
`useState(props.value)` reads the prop only once; later prop changes are ignored.
